title: Marketing Manager
description:
Paid Performance Marketing Manager
- Norwich
- Hybrid 1-day from home
- Competitive Salary

Brief

We're working with an ambitious and growing business looking to appoint a Paid Performance Marketing Manager to take ownership of their paid acquisition strategy across both Paid Search and Paid Social channels.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced digital marketer who thrives on data, optimisation and driving measurable results. You'll be responsible for planning, executing and optimising campaigns that generate high-quality leads, increase brand visibility and maximise return on advertising spend.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and optimise Paid Search campaigns across Google Ads and Bing.
- Develop and execute Paid Social campaigns across platforms including Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok.
- Monitor campaign performance and analyse key metrics including ROI, ROAS, CPA and conversion rates.
- Conduct keyword research, audience targeting and competitor analysis.
- Manage advertising budgets and ensure spend is allocated effectively.
- Deliver regular performance reports and provide strategic recommendations.
- Work closely with internal teams to align campaigns with wider marketing and commercial objectives.
- Test and implement new channels, audiences, creatives and optimisation strategies.
- Drive continuous improvements through A/B testing and data-led decision-making.

Requirements
- Proven experience managing Paid Search and Paid Social campaigns.
- Strong understanding of Google Ads, Google Analytics and Meta Ads Manager.
- Experience working with significant advertising budgets.
- Highly analytical with strong reporting and data interpretation skills.
- Commercially focused with a track record of delivering measurable results.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Desirable
- Experience with LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Ads or TikTok Ads.
- Knowledge of SEO and broader digital marketing channels.
- Experience using marketing automation or CRM platforms.

Salary: Competitive

This role would suit a Performance Marketing Manager, Digital Marketing Manager, Paid Media Manager, PPC Manager or Growth Marketing professional looking to make a significant impact within a growing business.
